Department Description

The Team Corporate Underwriting & Analysis is part of the Corporate Risk Management Division of Erste Group Bank AG (Holding) and consists of a fair mix of underwriters and business analysts. It deals with corporate risk matters of Austrian and International Corporate Clients with strong focus on CEE.

The core competence consists in analyzing, recommending and/or taking credit decisions for corporate customers.  * Participating in client meetings

 * Contribution to various Group and Department projects alongside the credit process

jobs.description: 1 Master Thesis "Bi-Static Sensing of UAVs" - JOB ID: 269595  * Reliable detection and localisation of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is becoming increasingly important for future civilian and commercial applications. This master's thesis focuses on the development and experimental validation of antenna arrays for bi-static sensing of UAVs using software-defined radio technology. * Under the guidance of our team, you will design, build, and characterise circularly polarised patch antennas for different array geometries for UAV sensing applications. * You will integrate the antenna arrays into an SDR-based testbed and perform experimental validation. * You will support us in developing simulation models for bi-static multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) sensing and realise a real-time measurement setup that can estimate azimuth, elevation and range. * You will gain hands-on experience with antenna design, beamforming, direction-of-arrival estimation, and software-defined radio systems. * You will learn how to validate the sensing algorithms using a state-of-the-art motion capture system. * You will work closely with researchers in wireless sensing and contribute to the development of next-generation UAV detection and localisation technologies.Your qualifications: * You are pursuing a master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Physics, or a related field. * First experience (e.g. gained through university / student research projects, laboratory work, internships or similar activities) in at least one of the following areas: (i) Antenna array design and validation measurements or (ii) micro-Doppler-based bi-static sensing methods. In the cover letter, the candidate shall describe how their CV and personal interests for future development match at least one of the above profiles (explicitly referring to (i) or (ii)) and substantiate their claimed expertise. Please note that applications that do not address this point may not be considered further. * You have a basic understanding of antennas, electromagnetics, and wireless communications. * Experience with RF measurement equipment, software-defined radio (SDR), or antenna simulation tools (e.g., CST, HFSS, or FEKO) is advantageous. * Programming experience in Python, MATLAB, or C++ for signal processing, beamforming, or bi-static sensing applications is beneficial. * You enjoy developing hardware prototypes and numerical algorithms, as well as performing experimental validation. * English language skills commensurate with the roleWhat to expect: * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months * Start date: as soon as possible - however, there is some flexibility regarding the start date * EUR 1.379,60 gross per month for 20 hours/week. * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results. * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities). jobs.description: 1 Master Thesis "Differentiable Ray Tracing for Radio Propagation Modeling" - JOB ID: 269596  * Differentiable ray-tracing frameworks such as Sionna RT have become powerful tools for wireless channel modeling. Wir suchen 1 SOC Analyst with German (f/m/d) @ A1 Competence Delivery Center As a Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst, you will play a key role in protecting customer environments against cyber threats. You will monitor security events, investigate incidents, coordinate response activities and support customers in maintaining a strong security posture.

The role combines hands-on cybersecurity operations with incident investigation and customer-focused security support, providing exposure to diverse technologies, threat landscapes and international security environments.

Responsibilities

Security Monitoring & Detection

Monitor customer environments for security threats, suspicious activities and policy violations, ensuring timely identification of potential risks.

Alert Analysis & Triage

Analyze and prioritize security alerts generated by SIEM, EDR/XDR, network, cloud and other security technologies, determining appropriate response actions.

Incident Investigation

Investigate security incidents, assess their severity, impact and business relevance, and distinguish between true positive and false positive events.

Incident Escalation & Response Support

Escalate validated incidents to customer security teams in accordance with established procedures and SLAs, while supporting incident response activities when required.

Customer Communication

Communicate incident details, recommendations and investigation findings to customers in a clear, professional and customer-oriented manner.

Threat Analysis & Correlation

Correlate information from multiple data sources to identify malicious activity, emerging threats and attack patterns across complex environments.

Documentation & Continuous Improvement

Document investigations, findings and response actions within ticketing and case management systems, while contributing to threat hunting, detection improvements and SOC process optimization.

Collaboration & Security Enhancement

Work closely with international colleagues, customers and technology partners to strengthen overall security capabilities and improve customer security posture.

Your Profile

 * Experience in a Security Operations Center (SOC), Managed Security Services, Incident Response or a similar cybersecurity role

 * Good understanding of cybersecurity threats, attack techniques and incident handling processes

 * Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar or similar technologies

 * Familiarity with EDR/XDR solutions, Microsoft Defender, network security monitoring and cloud security services

 * Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to assess and prioritize security events effectively

 * Experience working in a customer-facing environment and communicating technical findings to various audiences

 * Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple incidents and maintain attention to detail

 * German language proficiency at C1 level or native speaker (mandatory)

 * Strong English communication skills

The minimum annual gross salary under the collective agreement of Telekom Austria AG for this position is EUR 51.042,74 (40-hour full-time work week). Depending on qualifications and professional experience, there is a willingness to offer a higher salary.

We're now looking for a Product Manager with experience in the construction industry to take our platform to the next level- owning the roadmap, pricing, and scope along the way. Not managing. Shaping.

Your mission

 * The roadmap across all product areas. You decide what ships next - and you stand behind the why.

 * The path from prototype to platform. You sequence the porting effort in waves, cut scope where it's needed, and keep the codebases together instead of letting them drift apart.

 * The written trail. PRDs, a well-maintained decision log, release notes. Our rule: if it isn't documented, it didn't happen.

 * Product management experience in a B2B SaaS environment - with substantial time spent on a technical or data-intensive product.

 * Experience in - or hands-on exposure to - the construction industry.

 * An AI-native way of working: for you, AI is a tool, not a buzzword.

jobs.description: From DEV bench to center stage -- build the future of streaming.   At BIG BLUE MARBLE, we enable easy access to broadcast content in Austria while driving innovation and customer service in media delivery. Our mission is to actively shape the digital future of TV and radio. By continuously optimizing the media experience for our customers, we provide innovative streaming solutions while pursuing sustainable practices for a climate-friendly broadcasting landscape. To lead our Innovation & Research LAB -- publicly known as BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs (labs.bigbluemarble.com) -- at ORS comm GmbH & Co KG, we are looking for a: Program Lead, BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs, all genders Are you a developer at heart who's ready for the next chapter -- one where you spend less time in the IDE and more time shaping which technologies your company bets on next? Do you want to turn prototypes into real business impact, represent your company on international stages, and build the innovation ecosystem of a streaming platform from the ground up? If you have a technical background and the ambition to grow into a coordinating, outward-facing leadership role, BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs is where you belong. Your responsibilities:   Innovation  Scouting Innovation is not an end in itself for us. We want to understand early which technologies will shape the streaming world of tomorrow -- and which of them are actually relevant for our platform and our customers. You scout new technologies, solutions, start-ups, and trends in the streaming and media-tech space. You analyze technological developments and assess their relevance and potential applications for our products. You attend industry conferences, trade fairs, and events at home and abroad, build a relevant network, and bring fresh impulses into the company. You work closely with our Innovation Management and Professional Services team to move promising technologies from first assessment through to potential Proofs of Concept. You translate your findings into clear, digestible formats and share your knowledge internally and externally -- through technical blog posts, presentations, or trend and technology analyses. AI and automation are a permanent part of your technology radar -- always with an eye on concrete use cases in the streaming and platform environment. Innovation Lab & Proof of Concept Program You lead the operational activities of BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs and coordinate its day-to-day innovation processes. You organize and facilitate our bi-weekly Proof of Concept (PoC) sprints together with our Full Stack Development team. Together with Product Management, you evaluate ideas entering the innovation funnel, prioritize opportunities, and initiate new PoCs. You coordinate PoCs from idea validation to successful completion, ensuring transparency, alignment, and effective collaboration across technical and business teams. You make sure PoC outcomes are properly documented and turned into reusable knowledge, technical assets, or follow-up initiatives. You continuously improve our Lab processes, fostering an agile, execution-oriented innovation culture. Innovation Ecosystem & Strategic Partnerships You represent BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs nationally and internationally within the innovation ecosystem -- universities, research institutions, public organizations, start-ups, and technology partners. You act as a key contact for strategic collaborations and help identify opportunities for joint innovation and research initiatives. You represent BIG BLUE MARBLE at conferences, workshops, exhibitions, and industry events, expanding our professional network and visibility. You contribute to strategic initiatives across the organization, supporting new partnerships and innovation opportunities. Knowledge Transfer & Innovation Communication You ensure innovation outcomes are communicated effectively, internally and externally. You support the creation of technical blogs, conference papers, exhibition contributions, presentations, and other dissemination formats. You prepare management-ready summaries, technology assessments, and recommendations based on PoC results and emerging technology trends. You promote knowledge sharing across teams and help translate innovation into long-term business value. Your background: A technical foundation, not necessarily a management CV. You have worked as a (Full Stack) Software Developer, Engineer, or in a comparable hands-on technical role -- and you understand modern software development, cloud technologies, and digital platforms from the inside. A Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a comparable technical discipline -- helpful for writing well-founded technical papers and conference contributions. Equivalent professional experience is welcome in place of a formal degree. A genuine wish to change direction: you're ready to trade day-to-day coding for coordinating people, representing the company externally, and shaping innovation strategy. Prior exposure to project or product coordination is a plus, not a requirement. Streaming and broadcast media know-how is very welcome -- but if you bring strong technical fundamentals, we're confident you can build this knowledge quickly on the job. You're comfortable presenting, networking, and representing BIG BLUE MARBLE confidently in front of external audiences -- at conferences, workshops, and partner meetings. You enjoy structuring ambiguous, early-stage ideas, coordinating people across disciplines, and turning promising concepts into tangible outcomes. Experience contributing to technical blogs, conference papers, white papers, or presentations is a strong asset. Comfortable working in agile environments and facilitating sprint-based collaboration. Experience with universities, research institutions, start-ups, or technology partners is a plus. Fluent English (C1/C2) and German (minimum B2) are required. What we're proposing for you: In addition to an annual salary in line with the market, we offer you a package of benefits consisting of a mobility allowance for the Wiener Linien annual ticket or the KLIMATICKET, a company canteen, our bonus programme, the pension fund and a sports programme. Place of work: Vienna (remote option), working hours: 38,5hours per week, reference number: OC1026CINSE, starting date: 10/2026. We are happy to offer professionals with relevant training and experience a gross annual salary in line with the market of between 56,000 and 72,000 euros (salary group 4, Telekom-KV, 38,5 h/week)*. Remote work Good communication and direct cooperation are very important to us. You can work from home, from the modern office or hybrid. In practice, this means that, according to your preferences, you will benefit from working remotely or from an office in Vienna with a great location and a cool atmosphere. We are happy to talk about the details in a meeting.  Travel This position includes occasional national and international business travel, with an expected travel commitment of up to four weeks per year, primarily for conferences, trade fairs, workshops, partner meetings, and industry events. *For legal reasons, we are required to state the minimum salary as per the collective agreement. For this position, it is  EUR 3.523,02 gross/month (Qualification Group 4, Specialist Level, Telekom collective agreement 2026, full-time).  Why join us: You're passionate about media technology and want your career to move from building things to shaping what gets built next. You bring a technical foundation, curiosity about streaming and broadcasting, and the communication skills to be a trusted voice -- internally and externally. Analytical thinking, the ability to navigate complex, ambiguous topics, and genuine enthusiasm for realization complete your profile. This is you?  Contact us via karriere.ors.at  We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and especially welcome individuals from underrepresented groups.

We are expanding our international security operations and are looking for highly reliable and professionally qualified 1 EXECUTIVE PROTECTION SPECIALIST / CLOSE PROTECTION OFFICER International Assignments - Armed & Unarmed Protection in Europe and worldwide.

This is an opportunity for experienced security professionals who are looking for serious international assignments, professional working conditions and attractive compensation.

WHAT WE OFFER

 * starting compensation from €5,000 net per month

 * additional compensation depending on qualification, responsibility and assignment

 * international assignments

 * opportunities throughout Europe and worldwide

 * travel, accommodation and meals depending on assignment

 * long-term employment opportunities

 * professional operational planning

 * training and development opportunities

 * challenging and varied assignments

 * opportunities to develop within an international security organisation

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

 * executive Protection

 * close Protection

 * protection of private clients, executives, entrepreneurs and VIPs

 * international travel security

 * advance work and security preparation

 * threat and risk assessment

 * secure transportation and transfers

 * venue and residential security

 * event security

 * coordination with international security partners

 * professional reporting and operational debriefing

ARMED & UNARMED PROTECTION

We are recruiting professionals for both unarmed and armed protection assignments.

Armed assignments are conducted only where legally permitted and where the required licences, authorisations and qualifications are in place.

IDEAL BACKGROUND

We are particularly interested in candidates with professional experience in:

 * Executive Protection / Close Protection

 * Military

 * Police / Law Enforcement

 * Justice / Corrections

 * Professional Security

 * Government security services

 * International security companies

DESIRABLE QUALIFICATIONS

 * recognised Close Protection / Executive Protection training

 * international operational experience

 * tactical or security-related additional training

 * advanced first aid / medical training

 * defensive and security driving experience

 * excellent English

 * additional languages are an advantage

 * valid driving licence

 * willingness to travel internationally

 * ability to work discreetly and professionally in demanding environments

PERSONAL QUALITIES

We expect:

 * absolute reliability

 * discretion and confidentiality

 * professional appearance and conduct

 * excellent judgement

 * calmness under pressure

 * flexibility

 * strong teamwork

 * high level of responsibility

 * professional communication

 * willingness to undertake international assignments

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for professional protection specialists, not conventional guarding personnel.

If you have a proven background in military, law enforcement, close protection or professional security and are interested in building a career in international Executive Protection, we would like to hear from you.

APPLICATION

 Please submit:

 * CV / résumé

 * relevant qualifications and certificates

 * professional experience

 * close protection / executive protection qualifications

 * language skills

 * driving qualifications

 * international availability

 * references where available

Join a professional international Executive Protection team and take your security career to the next level and send your documents to office@sheriff.at

Important: All assignments, particularly armed assignments, are subject to the applicable laws, licences and authorisations of the relevant country and assignment location.

MR Sec

Deine zukünftigen Aufgaben

In the Position as Staff Research Engineer you are responsible for the central PDK function across SAL's technology platforms and pilot-line activities. You ensure that PDK content, models, verification flows, documentation, and release processes are consistent, traceable, and aligned with fabrication capabilities-enabling reliable design-to-fab handshakes for internal teams and open-access users (with a strong relevance for integrated photonics and related quantum/MEMS device concepts).

Your responsibilities include:

 * PDK strategy & roadmap: define and maintain a consolidated PDK roadmap (priorities, maturity targets, releases) aligned with platform and fabrication evolution.

 * PDK governance & release management: establish a structured release process (versioning, release notes, change control, qualification evidence, deprecation rules) and ensure predictable delivery for users.

 * Design-to-fab interface: act as the interface between designers and fabrication teams to align layer definitions, design rules, tolerances, process assumptions, sign-off criteria, and handover packages.

 * PDK content quality: own quality of PDK deliverables such as DRC/LVS/PEX flows (as applicable), models, corners/variability knobs, examples, and user documentation.

 * Validation & calibration: coordinate validation and calibration plans with measurement/metrology and process teams; ensure model updates are evidence-based and traceable to wafer data.

 * EDA and enablement flows: maintain compatibility with relevant EDA toolchains; provide reference flows, templates, and automation where beneficial (build/release tooling, regression checks).

 * User support & enablement: support internal teams and selected external open-access users (onboarding, requirements clarification, feedback capture) and translate user needs into backlog items.

 * Documentation & know-how management: ensure strong documentation discipline and coordinate what can be shared externally vs what must be protected, in collaboration with responsible functions.

 * Strong experience (min. 8+ years) in PDK development and design enablement (verification flows, models, documentation, releases) in a semiconductor / photonics / MEMS-related environment.

 * MSc/PhD in EE, Physics, Photonics, Microsystems, or comparable.

 * Solid understanding of the design-fabrication interface and how process variability impacts models, rules, and design margins.

 * Hands-on experience with EDA ecosystems and PDK integration; scripting/automation skills (e.g., Python/TCL) are a strong plus.

 * Experience working with wafer data for model calibration/validation and structured change control.

 * Strong communication skills and ability to coordinate across a matrix organization (design, process teams, metrology, external users).

 * Fluent English; German is a plus.
